transient_message_surface_label: Example transient-message posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded status-message surface for official voter-information routes that use transient alerts, toasts, or snackbar-style updates.

reviewed_message_classes.durable_visible_equivalent_note: The same no-match state stays visible above the recovery/help options after the status message is announced.
reviewed_message_classes.replacement_policy_note: Later advisory messages do not replace the no-match state until the user changes the lookup inputs.

reviewed_message_classes.durable_visible_equivalent_note: The page also preserves the same pending state and next steps in visible confirmation text below the form.
reviewed_message_classes.replacement_policy_note: The toast may dismiss after review, but the visible confirmation state persists and is not replaced by cosmetic success animations.

severity_mapping_note: Advisory updates use status posture; urgent warnings use alert posture; interactions that require a decision move to a more durable inline or dialog treatment.
durable_visibility_note: Any meaning that controls the voter's interpretation of the route remains visible in route text after the transient message disappears.
auto_dismiss_and_replacement_note: Transient messages either remain until dismissed or leave behind an equivalent durable state; replacement/stacking rules are reviewed so decisive messages are not lost.
focus_and_live_region_note: Live-region containers exist before content updates, and ordinary transient messages do not steal keyboard focus.
interactive_content_boundary_note: The toast/status layer is used for text updates rather than as the sole home for links, buttons, or confirmation decisions.
search_result_status_note: Result-count, loading, and no-result messages are announced and also remain inspectable in durable route text.
message_frequency_note: Notification cadence is bounded so multiple messages do not overwhelm or mask one another during a single voter task.
compact_mobile_note: Compact/mobile layouts preserve the same outcome meaning without clipping it into a vanishing overlay that cannot be revisited.
